name: phronix_contribute
description: Contribute what this project learned about another project's capabilities back to it. The upstream clones stay on their integration branch (develop); these tools pull latest (replaying local contribution commits, conflicts merged, the agent for anything that is not a lesson, worked entry or capability.json), push the commits on a new contrib/<project>-<date-time> branch with its pull-request link, and switch the clone back to develop. Load when the user asks to pull, push, rebase, switch or contribute back.

history.why: rebase with merging, and push, for contributions up the chain

history.note: clones stay on develop; push makes a new branch; contrib_switch
